question: 已知 $f(x)$ 是三次多项式，且有 $\lim_{x\to 2a}\frac{f(x)}{x - 2a} = \lim_{x\to 4a}\frac{f(x)}{x - 4a} = 1$ ，求 $\lim_{x\to 3a}\frac{f(x)}{x - 3a}$ .
answer: \begin{array}{c} f (x) = (A x + B) (x - 2 a) (x - 4 a), \\ \lim _ {x \to 2 a} \frac {f (x)}{x - 2 a} = \lim _ {x \to 2 a} (A x + B) (x - 4 a) = (2 a A + B) (- 2 a) = 1, \\ \lim _ {x \to 4 a} \frac {f (x)}{x - 4 a} = \lim _ {x \to 4 a} (A x + B) (x - 2 a) = (4 a A + B) (2 a) = 1. \end{array}
